name: hmi_create_discrete_alarm
description: Create or update a WinCC Unified discrete alarm with an alarm class, HMI tag trigger, and multilingual event text.

raised_state_tag.description: Existing HMI tag that raises the alarm.

raised_state_tag_bit_number.description: Bit number in the trigger tag (default: 0).

acknowledgment_control_tag.description: Optional existing HMI tag used to control acknowledgment.
